author: Codex documentation author agent; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (knowledge)

prerequisites: Shared seeded entities lab openlaw-docs-41255c61-entities built from 3fa407e3, with the seeded Knowledge types and folders.
Reviewer fixtures from docs/documentation/batches/DOC-029/knowledge/fixtures/build-fixtures.py (fictional PDF and DOCX files), copied under run-specific DOC-029 knowledge names.
Nadia Haddad signed in with the seed password in her own browser context.
scenarios.expected: The item, its guidance, its folder, and its Documents remain distinct records with a working primary choice. Unavailable/archived references and insufficient role permissions have supported outcomes.
scenarios.actual: 20 recorded steps passed as Nadia Haddad. Knowledge opened from the navigation. Add folder made a top-level folder and a child under the selected folder. New from files started Folder at Library or at the selected folder; choosing two PDFs, Type Precedent and Create drafts opened the first item and listed the second, each a Draft, Legal Only item named after its file with its own primary Document. Title saved on Enter and on leaving the field, Type and Folder saved on change, and all survived a reload. New Knowledge Item with Attach documents and Document kind: with the upload request dropped by the reviewer's browser, the item existed and the dialog offered Retry failed uploads and Continue; Retry uploaded the file, which became primary automatically, and Continue opened the item with no Document. Add guidance and Preview saved the source on blur and rendered heading, emphasis, list, code and link; a raw <b> tag was not rendered as HTML; Edit and a reload kept the source. Upload added a second Document; Set as primary (absent on the primary row) moved the Primary mark and the Primary document control; Open preview opened the current Version 1; Add version on the supporting Document made Version 2 on that chain only. Archiving the primary Document removed its row, chose no replacement and kept its Version and designation; Show archived and Restore returned it. The Documents section had no New folder control, and a Choose folder import placed its file at the item root. A folder listed its descendants; Type, State, Audience, Author and Format each narrowed the list and Clear filters restored it. Rename or move selected folder excluded the folder and its child from Parent folder and saved a rename and a move. Move up and Move down changed the saved sibling order and back. Delete selected folder said nothing is deleted and moved the child folder and its item to the parent. No Manage types… link was offered to the Legal Team Member. A DOC-029 archived Knowledge type was absent from the record and both create dialogs. Archiving an item disabled Title, Type, Folder, Audience and guidance, removed Upload, and a direct upload answered 409; the saved address reopened it and Restore made it editable.

Reviewer fixtures from docs/documentation/batches/DOC-029/knowledge/fixtures/build-fixtures.py (fictional PDF and DOCX files), copied under run-specific DOC-029 knowledge names.
scenarios.expected: Help search does not search Knowledge Items or their files.
scenarios.actual: Help search found the guide "Create and organize Knowledge Items" by its title. A search for the Knowledge Item title "DOC-029 knowledge LTM E48831 guidance" answered "No matching articles".

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

The entities lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Only records named DOC-029 knowledge were created. The archived Knowledge type fixture was created, archived and deleted by the run. Development runs before the recorded run E48831 left further DOC-029 knowledge drafts and folders; they are not credited (see harnessNotes in the walkthrough log).
The failed-upload outcome was produced by the reviewer's browser dropping the upload request, not by a server refusal.

Not exercised: the no-active-type message, the reload advice after someone changes types or folders mid-edit, permanent Document deletion, saved views and global search, and preview processing or failure recovery. Those behaviours belong to linked guides or were read from source only.
The Business User negative check used Business Portal sessions; the seed gives Ravi Menon no password, so a staff sign-in by password was not possible.
The walkthrough ran on app commit 3fa407e3, which differs from edition.json supportedAppCommit 7f7e917a; the edition re-pin is outside this record.

compatibilityReview.summary: I inspected the app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38 and found no change to Knowledge folders, type choices, guidance or Knowledge Item Documents. I replayed the round 1 V-C33 walkthrough on the entities2 lab as a Legal Team Member, an Administrator and a Business User, and all 40 steps passed.
